description: Somos "11:22 Labs", creadores de NOVA-SYNC, un software médico Edge-AI y bio-telemetría espacial. Nos apasiona la neurociencia, la IA y la medicina aeroespacial. Buscamos mentes innovadoras: desarrolladores (Three.js, frontend), diseñadores UI/UX o profesionales de la salud. Únete para crear el futuro de la telemedicina autónoma y proteger a los astronautas rumbo a Marte. ¡Hagamos historia!
summary: Developed by 11:22 Labs, NOVA-SYNC (Neuro-Optical Vital Assessment & Sync) is an autonomous Edge-AI clinical decision support and 3D multimodal telemetry software platform for deep-space crew health monitoring. During Lunar Gateway (NRHO) and Mars transit missions, communication delays reach up to 22 minutes one-way, eliminating live ground medical support. NOVA-SYNC addresses this challenge by fusing synthetic bio-telemetry from a conceptual 4.2g ultrathin forehead sensing array (integrating 760/850nm fNIRS, graphene dry EEG, cMUT ultrasound, microfluidic sweat aptasensors, and transcutaneous PtcCO2) with existing ISS and Gateway flight hardware: CSA Astroskin, the CSA CANS neutron spectrometer, and NASA Tempus Pro. Operating 100% autonomously on board, the platform detects early biomarker signatures for Major Depressive Disorder, acute ischemic stroke (CVA) from jugular venous stasis, Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), and radiation-induced neuro-toxicity, while preventing false-positive alarms caused by microgravity CO2 pockets. NOVA-SYNC empowers astronauts and flight surgeons with real-time 3D visualization and automated NASA HRP countermeasures when Earth is out of reach.
details:
What It Does & How It Works NOVA-SYNC transforms fragmented physiological, biochemical, and environmental signals into actionable clinical intelligence through a 5-stage on-board pipeline. It ingests synthetic telemetry from a conceptual TRL-2 3-layer smart epidermal forehead membrane (4.2g flexible array tethered to an 18g behind-the-ear BLE pod operating at a 42 mW duty-cycled power budget) and synchronizes it via a Bluetooth Low Energy Body-Area Network with CSA Astroskin (ECG, blood pressure, SpO2), CSA CANS (neutron radiation dosimetry), and NASA Tempus Pro. A 4-Quadrant Mission Control Dashboard visualizes real-time cortical hemodynamics on an interactive 3D brain model, streams 60 FPS waveforms (Frontal EEG, P1/P2 intracranial compliance pulse morphology, and ECG), tracks an estimated Nocturnal Glymphatic Clearance Index, and triggers automated NASA Human Research Program (HRP) protocols across five live scenarios.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Deep-Space Medical Autonomy: Eliminates reliance on real-time Earth telemedicine during 22-minute Mars communication blackouts by providing instant, explainable on-board triage.
  • Crew Empowerment: Features a Dual-Role Toggle that switches between a technical Flight Surgeon View and a plain-language Astronaut Self-Assessment View with an interactive ARCHeR countermeasure adherence checklist.
  • Earth Telemedicine Blueprint: Because microgravity acts as an accelerated model of vascular and neurological aging, NOVA-SYNC establishes a scalable framework for remote geriatric, stroke, and mental health monitoring in rural communities on Earth.

Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware & Software

  • Software & Languages: Built as a zero-build, lightweight Single-Page Application using HTML5, Tailwind CSS, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Three.js (WebGL 3D volumetric rendering), and a 60 FPS HTML5 2D Canvas oscilloscope with built-in CSV telemetry export and instant EN/ES bilingual support.
  • Flight & Conceptual Hardware: Designed for interoperability with CSA Astroskin Bio-Monitor, CSA CANS Spectrometer, NASA Tempus Pro, CortiVision PhotonGrav fNIRS, and our conceptual TRL-2 epidermal sensing patch.

Creativity & Factors Considered

  • Cross-Modal False-Positive Filtering (Scenario 5): In microgravity, stagnant exhaled CO2 forms localized pockets around an astronaut's head, causing lethargy and cerebral vasodilation that single-sensor systems misdiagnose as depression or stroke.
  • Automated ECLSS Action: NOVA-SYNC cross-checks elevated transcutaneous PtcCO2 (54.8 mmHg) against normal sweat Cortisol and S100B levels to rule out vascular or psychiatric crises and automatically boosts cabin ECLSS ventilation fans to 100%.
  • Engineering & Clinical Realism: Our team accounted for spacecraft power/mass constraints (1-minute duty cycling every 15 minutes at 42 mW), motion-artifact filtering, and non-invasive intracranial compliance estimation via P2/P1 pulse wave inversion rather than invasive lumbar punctures.
